title: C5 composition representation and execution budget audit
question: Which registered representation and verifier-coupled training interventions reduce compositional rank degradation and the admission-to-execution budget loss in the persistent relational C5 loop?
held_constant: two persisted 16-bit operands plus persisted operation
three-boundary persistence delay with three decoy writes
opaque address plus one-bit-corrupted public operation hint
64 calibration trials and 64 held-out trials per seed/M

splits.rule: calibration and held-out episode keys must have zero intersection; counts and SHA256 digests are emitted

diagnostics: per-operation XOR/XNOR/AND/OR Top-1 and mean rank
baseline explicit a*b pairwise feature presence
per-seed mean-rank and P90 bootstrap 95% CIs at M=1024
mean dense rank as exact-verifier expected executions
empirical L90(M) sweep using integer L in [1,128]
pooled L90 power fit and mean-execution power fit

arms.name: control
arms.intervention: existing CDLPersistentRelationRouter with matched 1200 exhaustive updates

arms.name: analytic_init
arms.intervention: exact Boolean relation initialization followed by matched 1200 exhaustive updates

arms.name: product_key
arms.intervention: candidate descriptor split into two 8-bit product-key subspaces with learned 8-D subkeys

arms.name: late_interaction
arms.intervention: independent per-bit interaction channels with summed structured score

arms.name: outcome_distill
arms.intervention: control with 800 exhaustive plus 400 CASM-failure hard-negative updates

arms.name: product_key_distill
arms.intervention: product-key with 800 exhaustive plus 400 CASM-failure hard-negative updates

arms.name: late_interaction_distill
arms.intervention: per-bit interaction with 800 exhaustive plus 400 CASM-failure hard-negative updates

exact_reference.name: persistent relational hash solver
exact_reference.rule: derive all four relation descriptors from persisted operands, perform four descriptor-index hash lookups, select persisted operation
exact_reference.capability_expectation: rank 1 when the target descriptor is in the candidate population
exact_reference.runtime_in_M: O(1) after descriptor-to-index hash tables are built

sparse_protocol.L90: smallest integer L with at least 0.90 calibration target admission at each M
sparse_protocol.K90: 90th percentile dense target rank on calibration
sparse_protocol.budget_curve: execute admitted candidates in score order up to fixed B and stop on exact verification

adaptive_budget.rule: standardized rank-1 to rank-4 score margin: >=1.0 => B=1; >=0.5 => B=4; >=0.25 => B=8; otherwise B=16

primary_endpoints: pooled mean expected dense executions across M=64..8192
interpretation_rules: Use the exact solver only as a task-semantic capability/cost reference.
Treat mean dense rank as exact-verifier expected execution count only in the dense rank-ordered thought experiment.
Do not treat finite-range power fits as asymptotic theorems.
Do not select a representation using the held-out stream.
